title: The Moon's body-fixed frames of DE440: principal-axes orientation (binary PCK) and the frame kernel defining the mean-Earth frame
provider: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (lunar librations integrated with DE440), distributed by NAIF
format: moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc: SPICE binary PCK (DAF, little-endian), type-2 Chebyshev segments of the 3-1-3 Euler angles of the Moon's principal-axes frame (NAIF frame 31008, MOON_PA_DE440) relative to the ICRF; radians and seconds past J2000 TDB. moon_de440_250416.tf: SPICE text frame kernel; MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 (31009) is MOON_PA_DE440 turned by the constant angles (67.8526, 78.6944, 0.2785) arcseconds about the axes (3, 2, 1), which the astronomy domain's C++ carries and checks against the kernel's own example.
licence: Freely distributed by NAIF; cite the reference below
citation: Park, R. S., Folkner, W. M., Williams, J. G., & Boggs, D. H. (2021). The JPL Planetary and Lunar Ephemerides DE440 and DE441. The Astronomical Journal, 161(3), 105.
